concepts.name: Grade 10 | Geography 148 Africa, Central
concepts.simple_definition: Grade 10 | Geography 148 Africa, Central Africa, and Western Africa, represented about 93.5% of the population of the continent in 2015
concepts.deep_explanation: In the period between 1980 – 2015, they had high rates of population growth of 2.9%, 3.0% and 2.7% per year on average respectively

concepts.simple_definition: HUMAN – NATURAL ENVIRONMENT INTERACTIONS UNIT SIX 149 The high growth in the world population over the past centuries is largely the result of advances in modern medicines and improvements in living standards
concepts.deep_explanation: These have significantly reduced infant, child and maternal mortality and have contributed to an increase in life expectancy of people
